patch.value: Add --format mermaid/graphml to graph cycles and critical-path

cycles and critical-path accept --format <text|mermaid|graphml> (default text); text/absent output byte-identical to today; mermaid/graphml build a SUBGRAPH (critical-path chain; or union of cycle nodes/edges) and render via the EXISTING renderMermaid/renderGraphml (no new renderers); cycles still exits 1 when cycles exist; invalid --format rejected with USAGE error; unit tests + README + changelog.

value.author: codex
value.text:
DESIGN & IMPLEMENTATION

Goal: let teams visualize a detected cycle or the critical path as a diagram for docs, without changing the existing text/JSON contract.

SUBGRAPH CONSTRUCTION (src/index.ts, new exported pure helpers near the analytics section):
- projectSubgraph(graph, nodeIds, edgeKeys): projects a subgraph from the full shaped graph. Keeps exactly the requested node ids (in order, de-duped), preserving each node's labels+properties from the source so the renderers emit real titles/statuses. Includes only relationships whose key (from->to) is in edgeKeys AND that are STRUCTURAL edges between requested nodes. It never invents an edge absent from the source graph (test: projectSubgraph never invents edges). Defensive: synthesizes a minimal PmItem node only if an id is missing from the source.
- criticalPathSubgraph(graph, chain): chain nodes + the consecutive chain edges (chain[i]->chain[i+1]).
- cyclesSubgraph(graph, cycles): union of all cycle-participating nodes (first-seen order, deterministic) + the consecutive edges around each cycle (cycle[i]->cycle[i+1]; closed paths so this includes the back-edge).

RENDERER REUSE (no new renderers): renderAnalysisDiagram(format, graph) dispatches to the EXISTING renderMermaid()/renderGraphml() used by 'pm graph export'. Verified by a test asserting renderAnalysisDiagram('graphml', sub) === renderGraphml(sub) byte-for-byte.

FLAG WIRING: added --format <text|mermaid|graphml> to the shared parseAnalyticsFlags (default 'text'), with parseAnalysisFormat() validating and throwing a USAGE CommandError on anything else (e.g. 'svg'). Both --format X and --format=X forms supported.
- critical-path: when format != text, prints renderAnalysisDiagram(format, criticalPathSubgraph(graph, chain)) to stdout and returns {ok,format,length,path,diagram}; text path returns the IDENTICAL {ok,length,path} object as before.
- cycles: when cycles exist AND format != text, prints the cycle subgraph diagram FIRST, then still throws the same CommandError (exit 1) — preserves CI-gating. No-cycles path is unchanged (format is a no-op since an empty diagram is meaningless). 

BYTE-IDENTICAL TEXT DEFAULT: integration test drives the real registered handlers against a throwaway pm workspace and asserts run(args:[]) deep-equals run(['--format','text']) and that text prints nothing to stdout. Pure-helper tests cover 'exactly the chain nodes' (mermaid) and 'only cycle nodes/edges' (graphml) with stable synthetic graphs.

TEST RESULTS: full suite 33 tests, 33 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped (pm 2026.6.9 present so integration tests ran). New tests: criticalPathSubgraph chain-only; critical-path --format mermaid exact chain nodes+edges; cyclesSubgraph cycle-only; cycles --format graphml only cycle nodes/edges (2 edges); projectSubgraph no-invented-edges; renderer-reuse equality; critical-path mermaid integration (text==no-flag, diagram printed, path preserved); cycles graphml integration (diagram printed THEN exit 1, both cycle nodes, 2 edges); invalid --format rejected.

ARCH CONSTRAINTS HONORED: pure helpers, no SDK runtime import (import type only elsewhere), offline (uses existing loadGraphForContext / pm list-all path), reuses shapeGraph+structuralEdges. README updated (cycles, critical-path, analytics intro). Changelog regenerated (changelog:check passes). release:check run locally.

patch.value: Implemented cycles/critical-path diagram format support with test coverage
